root: ^You: Officer — please, this is serious. The ship is going to strike an iceberg.
^Officer: That's quite enough. I won't have you frightening the passengers with wild talk.

c-0: ^You: I only want someone to check. Please — is there any way to be sure?

^Officer: (sighs, a little less harsh) Check? With what — my own two eyes? We don't even have the binoculars, if you must know. The key was taken ashore by mistake. Satisfied? Now, please, leave this to the crew. (walks off, muttering)
c-1: ^You: You have to believe me! We don't have much time!

^Officer: (sharper) Time for what? Enough of this— (catches himself, irritated but relents slightly) ...Even if I wanted to check, we've no binoculars up there. The key went ashore with an officer who should've known better. Now — stop causing a scene. (storms off)
c-2: ^You: Then look for yourself! Use binoculars!
^Officer: (snaps back) Binoculars? We don't even have access to them. The key was taken ashore by mistake. Now — stop causing trouble, and leave me be. (storms off)
